newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - July 25.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - July 25.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) has approved Westpac's A$1.44 billion bid for Bank of Melbourne, the Australian Financial Review said on Friday. A condition for the approval is that Westpac gives deposit-taking institutions access to its electronic banking network in Victoria at reasonable prices.

National Australia Bank (NAB) on Thursday released a weaker than expected quarterly earnings result. The bank's net profit was a flat A$504 million in the third quarter, and some banking analysts told Reuters they were looking to cut full-year forecasts by up to A$100 million for the year ending Septemper.
Property gruop Hudson Conway has pulled out of a bid consortium vying for the right to build Melbourne's Docklands Stadum project, leaving its partner Lend Lease as a sole bidder.

Lead and zinc producer Western Metals said on Thursday it had reduced its resource and reserve estimates for the Pillara project in Western Australia after completing an underground feasibility and drilling programme.
